_note: Copy and edit. 'command' is 'claude', 'codex' or an explicit argument list with {placeholders}. Every call is a fresh session; the conveyor refuses resume/continue/fork flags and requires the budget flags. Placeholders: {model} {max_turns} {item_usd} {cwd} {repo} {prompt_file} {auto_compact_tokens} {tool_output_tokens} {writable_roots} {network}. The prompt is sent on stdin. item_usd / item_tokens / item_timeout here override the batch-wide --item-* caps for that role. A codex worker reports tokens but not dollars: give prices_usd_per_mtok from jobs/necker-costs/PRICES.json or the gate is skipped.
